newsitem.title: GERMANY: Mannesmann soars on merger speculation.
newsitem.headline: Mannesmann soars on merger speculation.

text.p: Shares in German engineering and telecommunications company Mannesmann AG rose sharply on Thursday as talk that it and German utility group Veba could be planning to merge their telecommunications businesses circulated in the market.
Mannesmann shares soared to a new year-high of 692.20 marks in IBIS dealings and in bourse trade was up 28.50 marks, or over four percent, at 688 marks by 1118 GMT, off a bourse peak of 691.50 marks.
Meanwhile the DAX index of leading shares was also strongly ahead, at new record highs, up 42.68 points, or 1.49 percent, by 2,908.75 points.

But Mannesmann said it could not explain the dramatic rise in its share price and dismissed speculation of a possible takover attempt, saying it had no information one major investor was buying its shares.
